select IFNULL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_B), 0) AS balance from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION cmap
left join DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST di on cmap.prod_id=di.business_id and di.model_type = '02' AND DI.DATA_TYPE= 'PTL01'
LEFT JOIN chb_asset_info info ON cmap.asset_code=info.asset_code LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD ad ON info.CHB_ISSUER_ID=ad.CUSTOMER_ID AND ad.INDUSTRY IN ('10') WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CMAP.ENDDATE, '%Y-%m') = #{termId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and ad.customer_id is null and info.asset_type2 in ('1112','1113','1114','1115','1116','1117')
and cmap.rating is not null and cmap.rating in( select item_value from sys_datadict_list where dict_code='SVR_MAIN_GRADE' and item_code<= '04' )
and cmap.rating is not null and cmap.rating in ('AA','AA-','A+','A-')
and cmap.rating is not null and cmap.rating in( select item_value from sys_datadict_list where dict_code='SVR_MAIN_GRADE' and item_code>= '13' )
and cmap.rating is null
and di.institution_code=#{org, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select REPLACE(group_concat(t.remark),',','、') remark from ( select concat(t1.asset_name,'+',round(t1.balance/10000,2)) AS remark ,t1.balance as balance,t1.posAmt as posAmt,row_number() over(order by t1.balance desc) as idx from( select coalesce(info.asset_name,case when info.asset_type2 in ('1108','1902') then CONCAT(info.mdate-info.vdate,'天回购') when info.asset_type2 in ('1107','1901') then CONCAT(info.mdate-info.vdate,'天拆借')end, info.asset_code,'现金')as asset_name, sum(ifnull(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_B,0)) as balance, sum(ifnull(data.pos_amt,0)) as posAmt from chb_month_asset_position cmap
left join DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST di on cmap.prod_id=di.business_id and di.model_type = '02' AND DI.DATA_TYPE= 'PTL01'
left join chb_asset_info info ON cmap.asset_code=info.asset_code
left join chb_assets_basis_data data on cmap.asset_code=data.asset_id and data.value_date=#{endDate, jdbcType = DATE} and cmap.prod_id =data.prod_id
left join chb_assets_basis_data_nobtm data on cmap.asset_code=data.asset_id and data.value_date=#{endDate, jdbcType = DATE} and cmap.prod_id =data.prod_id
where DATE_FORMAT(cmap.ENDDATE, '%Y-%m') = #{termId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and cmap.ASSETVALUE_B is not null
and (cmap.assettype2='1299' or cmap.assettype2='1206')
and cmap.assettype2='1399'
and cmap.assettype2='2499'
and di.institution_code=#{org, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
group by coalesce(info.asset_name,case when info.asset_type2 in ('1108','1902') then CONCAT(info.mdate-info.vdate,'天回购') when info.asset_type2 in ('1107','1901') then CONCAT(info.mdate-info.vdate,'天拆借')end, info.asset_code,'现金') )t1 order by t1.balance desc ) t where t.idx<= 3 or t.posAmt>=1000000000
